chapters.title: Fund once. Keep working.
sentences: An agent making a thousand paid API calls should not need a thousand payment transactions.
AgentPay combines payment streams with Chainlink C R E to keep agents working within budget.

chapters.title: Streaming payments
sentences: Fund one session, then reuse it across paid requests.
The stream accrues payment over time while the agent uses the service.
C R E adds the intelligence: when to start, keep paying, or close.

chapters.title: Why CRE
sentences: Chainlink C R E brings external APIs and blockchain state into one workflow.
It compares Coinbase and Chainlink U S D C prices, checks service health, and reads balances and stream state.
Budget and rate checks turn those observations into OPEN, CONTINUE, CLOSE, or DENY.
The wallet applies the decision before signing.

chapters.title: Watch the stream work
sentences: This prompted demo tries a basic session and a premium request.
The wallet approves and opens the stream. Ten successful API requests reuse that session.
The healthy checkpoint returns CONTINUE.
Then we inject a provider outage. C R E returns CLOSE, and the wallet cancels the stream.

chapters.title: Settlement you can verify
sentences: Cancellation pays accrued earnings to the provider and returns the unused deposit to the agent.
The transaction receipts and recipient balance increase verify the settlement.
The C L I also anchors decision records with onchain audit receipts.

chapters.title: Budget stays in control
sentences: Next, the premium request exceeds the spending cap.
C R E returns DENY before a new session opens, keeping that proposed spend inside the configured policy.
